product_title: Handcrafted Shubh Labh Pearl Door Hanging
product_description: Add a touch of traditional elegance to your home with this handcrafted Shubh Labh door hanging. Featuring vibrant pink floral embellishments, a rich red center with golden Shubh Labh lettering, intricate golden detailing, and delicate pearl tassels, this decorative piece beautifully blends festive charm with Indian craftsmanship. Perfect for decorating main doors, entrances, pooja rooms, and festive spaces during Diwali, weddings, and other auspicious occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid contact with water, perfumes, and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Keep away from direct sunlight and excessive moisture to preserve the colours and embellishments.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling or damage.
Store in a dry place in a protective box when not in use.
